title: IDS and IPS: detecting versus blocking

videos.script: An intrusion detection system watches, and tells you. An intrusion prevention system watches, and stops it. Often it is the same program, in a different place. {{same}} In this lesson a sensor listens on the DMZ. A request for the shop's admin pages arrives from the internet, succeeds, and is written down. {{ids}} You will read that alert the way an analyst would, and find the one field that turns it into a finding. {{read}} Then the program moves onto the cable itself. One word in the rule changes, and the same request never arrives. {{ips}} Last, the two ways a blocker hurts the business it protects: a rule that is too broad, and a machine that stops. {{fail}}
